stem.text: Which graph correctly shows relative electronegativity plotted against relative atomic radius for the elements Na, Mg, Al and Si?

A.alt: Scatter graph of electronegativity (vertical) against atomic radius (horizontal). Si is lowest and leftmost; Al is above Si; Mg is right of and below Al; Na is rightmost and low.

B.alt: Scatter graph of electronegativity (vertical) against atomic radius (horizontal). Si is top-left; Al is below and right of Si; Mg is below and right of Al; Na is lowest and rightmost.

C.alt: Scatter graph of electronegativity (vertical) against atomic radius (horizontal). Si is lowest and leftmost; Al is above and right of Si; Mg is above and right of Al; Na is highest and rightmost.

D.alt: Scatter graph of electronegativity (vertical) against atomic radius (horizontal). Si is near the top; Al is below and left of Si; Mg is below and right of Al; Na is lowest and rightmost.
